entries.title: Psalms 87:1
segments: ¶<<Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A Song.>> His foundation is in the mountains of holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 87:2
segments: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion more than all the habitations of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 87:3
segments: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 87:4
segments: ¶I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon among them that know me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: this [man] was born there.

entries.title: Psalms 87:5
segments: And of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; and the Most High himself shall establish her.

entries.title: Psalms 87:6
segments: Jehovah will count, when he inscribeth the peoples, This [man] was born there. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 87:7
segments: As well the singers as the dancers [shall say], All my springs are in thee.
